about.en: Anonymous Cat (ZCAT) is a cat-themed meme token launched through the StonkFun launchpad as a Solana Token-2022 mint at HcRLc9VDgjLeK154xDawfb1dmVJ98DoSqcwTHGqiDeJR, where it trades against Zcash (ZEC). The mint charges a 3% transfer fee, which the project uses to buy ZEC that is airdropped to holders. It has no issuer backing and no project website beyond its StonkFun page.
